test(codeon): verify preferred authority in merged commits

Pin the GitHub provider to forwarding the sealed authority byte for byte
so a later change cannot re-derive it from the PR body or head branch,
and assert the landed smoke squash commit authenticates with the Issue
projection's preferred reference instead of the Workspace-key alias.

Restoring the smoke assertion required the smoke-e2e runner arms in
reconcile_unclosed_runtime_resources, which were gated on cfg(test)
alone and left the match non-exhaustive under that feature.
